policy: Research exclusions are not page deletions. They prevent the new draft cohort from duplicating an existing buying question, using an inaccurate product-family label, or entering an evidence category that this cohort cannot support safely.

exclusions.reason: Existing cable-modem roundup, exact modem reviews, and 2.5GbE cable-modem guide already answer this purchase.
The existing modem-router-combo-versus-separate guide already answers the same support, bridge-mode, voice-service, placement, and upgrade-path decision.
Existing Wi-Fi 7 router roundup and exact router reviews already cover the standalone-router decision.
Existing mesh roundup plus current Wi-Fi 7 Deco reviews and comparisons leave insufficiently independent intent for another generic family page.
Existing GL.iNet travel-router review and travel-router use-case guide already answer the same purchase.

Live product results and buying dimensions duplicate the mini-router-UPS intent: DC voltage, plug size, polarity, load, runtime, charging behavior, and battery safety.

This is a garage placement use case for the existing indoor/outdoor security-camera families, not a stable product class with a distinct purchasing specification.
